title: MM-OPERA: Benchmarking Open-ended Association Reasoning for Large Vision-Language Models
reasoning: The MM-OPERA benchmark includes a 'Cultural Reference' dimension that evaluates the ability of models to reason through religious art and symbolism. Specifically, the paper highlights success cases requiring models to demonstrate 'theological understanding' and 'precise use of religious concepts' when associating imagery related to the Last Supper and Christian sacraments.
